name: Tonn Ruray Café
improvements: Add a /concepts/tonn-ruray/menu/ secondary page with an illustrative-items disclaimer so the primary menu action completes the visit loop the design task promises.
Add a publishable café frontage or interior photograph when one becomes available — the concept currently relies on typography and the through-the-day card alone.
summary: The café is clearly separated from the apartments: the banner, strip toggle, brand sub-label, warm café identity and case-study notes all state that only the café is being redesigned while the apartment site is left alone and linked honestly. The Gertrude Stein headline and JUN24 menu critique match the live tonnruray.com site. Menu and booking controls use the standard inert placeholder pattern with a hero note explaining the PDF replacement; that is sufficient for publication though a menu secondary page would strengthen the core promise.
verificationNote: Verified open 24 July 2026; café confirmed as the failing half beneath apartment-first billing, with JUN24 menu PDF and no booking.
